scope: Illustrative scalar research only. Not aircraft data, a performance prediction, or physical validation. All study scenarios are chosen inputs, not flight observations.

span.source: Prior AERIS design input; no model metrology in this investigation

wing_area.source: Prior AERIS design input; no model metrology in this investigation

density.source: Chosen sea-level reference atmosphere; not field weather

kinematic_viscosity.source: Chosen approximate reference-air value; no temperature or viscosity measurement

gravity.source: Conventional standard gravity used for this calculation; not local gravimetry

prop_diameter.source: S06: Mejzlik PN 228108, 28 inches converted to metres; reference prop only

prop_rpm.source: S06: published performance SIMULATION reference speed, not installed DA120 RPM

prop_ct.source: S06 rev. 3.0: manufacturer-simulated static J=0 point at 5000 RPM; not a measurement

prop_cp.source: S06 rev. 3.0: manufacturer-simulated static J=0 point at 5000 RPM; not a measurement

prop_inertia.source: S06: estimated axial PROPELLER inertia; excludes spinner and engine rotating parts

roll_rate.source: Chosen body-roll screening scenario; not an AERIS roll-rate claim

perpendicular_body_rate.source: Chosen body rate exactly perpendicular to the shaft; not a measured maneuver

mass.source: Chosen sensitivity cases; 12.6 kg is also the S03 donor listing, with fuel state unresolved. None is an AERIS weighing.

airspeed.source: Chosen local/reference speeds; no predicted flight envelope or uniform powered-wing speed

frequency.source: Chosen sinusoidal frequencies for pure-delay phase arithmetic; no pilot bandwidth measurement

delay.source: Chosen pure delays; no device, actuator, frame-time or latency acceptance specification
